items.title: Chinese Tech Leaders Meet as US Prepares Chip Curbs
items.summary: Chinese business and technology leaders are gathering in Shenzhen ahead of the APEC CEO Summit. The talks unfold as the US Commerce Department adds licensing requirements for advanced chip sales to data centers in Southeast Asia and Brazil to close remote-access loopholes. (Source: Bloomberg)
